blocks.html: The Court had at one time resolved that the public penance (amende honorable) should also be made at the bar of the audience chamber (parquet de l'audience), on the day of the pronouncing of the decision. But afterwards it was considered that this rash fellow was of a shameless impudence and an immeasurable overweening, presumptuous, virulent, and more abounding in petulance of language than a Theon or an Archilochus, and that he would at every word have disturbed Monsieur the President who was pronouncing, and the assembly: wherefore it was on the contrary resolved, for this sole reason, that they would content themselves with the penance which should be made at the place of Artigat, where he had offended.
